bio.p1: I'm Caio Pacheco Prates, a systems developer driven by curiosity and the will to turn problems into solutions. I graduated in Systems Analysis and Development from Centro Universitário UniFG in August 2026.
bio.p2: I got there balancing work and study, which strengthened my discipline, my sense of responsibility and my drive to grow.
bio.p3: At <link>Forja Studio</link>, I build websites, landing pages and digital systems for companies and professionals, combining technology, functionality and attention to detail.
bio.p4: I enjoy learning new technologies and working with other people. My goal is to keep growing, take part in challenging projects and build a solid career in technology.
